name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.20.0: the fridge scale commands get dashboard controls. scale_read, scale_tare and scale_calibrate were reachable only from the browser console, which made provisioning a machine a paste-the-API-call job — fine for three machines, not for 46. The Controls tab now carries a SCALES section on gravity fridges: pick cabinet and basket, read the weight, or run a guided calibration that walks empty-basket tare, known-weight calibrate and a confirming read in that order, showing the machine's own reply after each step. Order is enforced rather than suggested, because calibrating an un-tared basket reads right at one weight and wrong at every other and nothing about it fails visibly. Tare's force flag sits behind a confirmation worded as 'the basket is empty', offered only for the machine's own empty-basket refusal. read_all_trays and probe_addresses are allow-listed (they were 400ing) and exposed as read-only bus diagnostics. Enqueue validation tightened: scale commands are fridge-only, basket must be a whole 1-16, and cabinet may be omitted on a single-door fridge but never on a double. New GET /machines/:deviceCode/commands/:id lets the dashboard poll one command instead of re-reading the whole history every two seconds. Cumulative over v6.19.
